justification: Both panels depict a single bearded profile figure facing right, with hair and beard rendered in the same distinctive convention of tight parallel rows of curls, wearing a patterned, fringed garment in shallow relief on a rectangular slab. A differs in showing a winged figure at full length holding a bucket-like handled vessel beside a stylized flowering plant, whereas B is a bust-level view with a tall headdress and no visible wings, attributes or accompanying motifs.
